# ADR-013: Reuse source missile steering with actual world environment

Status: chosen_for_missile_batch

Concerns: Q-behavior, Q-order, Q-reproduce

## Decision

AST-transplant only the unbounded original missile arithmetic, replacing fixed model friction/dt/tick with actual runtime inputs and retaining source phase comparisons. The real Bevy motion preparation calls it; existing admission/launch/field kernels remain single implementations.

## Rationale

The four original fixtures previously could not finish setup and the actual mode dispatch omitted source thrust. Variable-clock/friction original C++ cases exercise the 800ms boundary and both late-target branches.

## Alternatives

Keep missing missile acceleration or a fixed 1000ms/friction projection; duplicate the missile controller by hand.

## Consequences

Original launch/20-step/collider assertions, 42 scoped source transitions and future snapshot replay pass. Full interaction/target-loss/callback/configuration domains and required refinement remain open.
